items.definition:
Occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous or steady.
We experienced intermittent rain throughout the day.

relating to the study of weather and climate
The meteorological office issued a severe weather warning.

so small or unimportant as to be not worth considering
The damage to the car was negligible.

spreading widely throughout an area or a group of people
The smell of smoke was pervasive in the building.

inflicting or intended as punishment
The company faced punitive damages for its actions.

relating to or resembling a skeleton; very thin
The old building was reduced to a skeletal frame after the fire.

able to operate independently
This software can be used as a standalone application.

serving as a desirable model; excellent
Her dedication to the project was exemplary.

relating to or denoting an increase or addition, especially one of a series on a fixed scale
The project made incremental progress each week.

relating to or concerned with the art of rhetoric, or asked in order to produce an effect or to make a statement rather than to elicit information
He asked a rhetorical question, expecting no answer.

involving two political parties
The bill received bipartisan support.

deriving ideas, style, or taste from a broad and diverse range of sources.
Her musical taste is very eclectic, ranging from classical to rock.

(of a disease or condition) regularly found among particular people or in a certain area; (of a plant or animal) native or restricted to a certain country or area.
Malaria is endemic in tropical regions.

perfectly clean, neat, or tidy
Her house was always immaculate.

involving or characterized by sexual perversions or unusual sexual tastes
She had a kinky sense of humor.

running lengthwise; involving long-term study
The researchers conducted a longitudinal study over 20 years.

relating to the pelvis
The doctor examined the patient's pelvic area.

relating to or characteristic of a political approach that appeals to ordinary people
The candidate adopted a populist stance to gain votes.

relating to or having the power to predict
The model has strong predictive power for future trends.

austere; simple and lacking in comfort
His room was spartan, with only a bed and a desk.

lasting only for a short time; impermanent
The city has a large transient population.

not revealed or made known
The terms of the agreement remain undisclosed.

comparable
The human heart is analogous to a pump.

very old or old-fashioned
The word 'thee' is archaic in modern English.

familiar with and at ease in many different countries and cultures
New York is a truly cosmopolitan city.

Fair and impartial.
They sought an equitable solution for all parties involved.

Relating to the system of feudalism.
The feudal system dominated medieval Europe.

Relating to or caused by disease; compulsive or obsessive
He was a pathological liar.

Relevant or applicable to a particular matter
Please provide all pertinent information.

containing or using satire
The play was a satirical commentary on modern politics.

relating to or involving gratification of the senses and physical, especially sexual, pleasure
The artist used sensual colors in her painting.

thinly dispersed or scattered
The population in the desert is very sparse.

bright blue in color, like a cloudless sky
The calm sea reflected the azure sky.

relating to Byzantium or the Byzantine Empire; (of a system or process) excessively complicated, and typically involving a great deal of administrative detail
The company's internal procedures were so byzantine that no one understood them.

standing out so as to be clearly visible; attracting notice or attention
He felt conspicuous in his bright red suit at the formal event.

performed by or affecting only one person, group, or country involved in a situation, without the agreement of another or the others
The country made a unilateral decision to withdraw.

well meaning and kindly
The benevolent king was loved by his people.

Having or showing deep religious feeling or commitment.
She was a devout follower of her faith.

Too large or too small in comparison with something else.
The punishment was disproportionate to the crime.

Tending to cause disagreement or hostility between people.
The new policy proved to be highly divisive.

absolutely necessary
A good dictionary is an indispensable tool for language learners.

between stars
The movie depicted an epic interstellar journey.

relating to the pancreas
Pancreatic cancer is a serious disease.

relating to or denoting drugs that produce hallucinations and apparent expansion of consciousness; characterized by intense distortion of sensory perception
The band's music had a strong psychedelic influence.

resembling, or fit for, a monarch, especially in being magnificent or dignified
She walked with a regal bearing, as if she were a queen.

relating to or concerned with the interaction of social and economic factors
The study examined the socioeconomic impact of the new policy.

relating to aircraft or aeronautics
The aero industry is rapidly expanding.

Having lost the physical, mental, or moral qualities considered normal or desirable.
The once-grand building had become a degenerate ruin.

Relating to or characteristic of demons or evil spirits.
He had a demonic gleam in his eyes.

Of a dull grayish-brown color.
The horse was a dun color.

Becoming more and more rapid.
The company has seen exponential growth in sales.

relating to harmony; melodious
The choir produced a beautiful harmonic sound.

characterized by comprehension of the parts of something as interconnected to the whole
The doctor takes a holistic approach to patient care.

causing disruption or annoyance through being unwelcome or uninvited
The paparazzi were very intrusive, following her everywhere.

Very harmful or evil; cancerous.
The doctor confirmed the tumor was malignant.

Relating to or caused by microbes.
Scientists are studying the microbial life in the deep sea.

Failing to take proper care in doing something.
The company was found negligent in its safety procedures.

In its original condition; unspoiled.
The car was in pristine condition, as if it had just left the factory.

strange or mysterious, especially in an unsettling way
She had an uncanny ability to predict the future.

relating to a style of European art, architecture, and music of the 17th and early 18th centuries
The church was decorated in a baroque style.

conforming to a general rule or acceptable procedure
This text is considered canonical within the genre.

lasting for a very short time
She caught a fleeting glimpse of the deer in the forest.

many and various
The problem has manifold causes, making it difficult to solve.

relating to an early stage in evolutionary development; fundamental
He felt a primal urge to protect his family.
